verdict.rationale: Mastra Code's own edit tooling returns LSP diagnostics that flag errors or warnings introduced by an edit, so it does catch some problems before merge. Headless mode can also be embedded in CI scripts. There is no evidence of a diff-inspection or review view, or of running test or lint suites as pre-merge checks. missing for 10: documented diff inspection/review UI, explicit test/lint check execution before merging, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Returns Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics showing any errors or warnings introduced by the edit.
`runMC` never calls `process.exit` and never writes to global streams, so it is safe to embed in CI scripts and servers.
